label: Lussou et al. (2001)
units: PGA, PSA in g at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are anchor_only - one anchor branch (PGA / headline branch) is reproducible from the specification appendix, but the spectral table and a median kernel are not in the repository - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: Lussou et al. (2001)

magnitude.note: JMA magnitude, not Mw. Converting silently changes the model.

site.note: Derived from measured/extrapolated Vs30, so the mapping is published. Honour the boundaries exactly.
site.anchor_note: All four classes carry published PGA coefficients: A 0.617, B 0.721, C 0.845, D 0.891.

published_grid_summary.note: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table) gives the count and range only; no OpenQuake implementation and the paper is not openly available. Still RESOLVE.

parameters.equation: log PSA(f) = a(f)*M + b(f)*R - log(R) + c(site_class, f)

coefficients.needed: The frequency-dependent a(f), b(f) and per-class c(f) table. PGA coefficients (a 0.371, b -0.00254, c per class A-D, sigma 0.313) are now available. The magnitude scale is still not stated.

implementation_notes: The published equation is written 'log' without a stated base. RESOLVE whether log10 or ln before coding.
Test at every Vs30 class boundary and at both magnitude and distance extremes.
parameters.reason_for_inclusion: Smaller-event Japanese model with measured site velocities.
parameters.log_base_note: Resolved: the appendix states log_base 10, settling the ambiguity in the 'log PSA(f)' form.

resolution_provenance.magnitude.scale: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table) and Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): M scale MJMA; Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, section 2.170: 'Homogeneous determination of JMA magnitude'
resolution_provenance.distance.min_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, section 2.170: 'equation valid for 3.5 <= MJMA <= 6.3 and 10 <= rhypo <= 200 km' (data span 4*-600* km, Illustration 1)
resolution_provenance.distance.max_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, section 2.170: authors' stated validity, as above
resolution_provenance.component: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table) and Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): component code B (each horizontal as a separate observation)
